story.eslint.title: ESLint Presets
story.eslint.description: Different ESLint presets for different project types. Pick one, or combine presets — prettier must come last.
story.eslint.recommendedDesc: Base recommended config for plain TypeScript/JavaScript projects.
story.eslint.reactDesc: For React projects: react-recommended or react-all.
story.eslint.vueDesc: For Vue projects: vue-recommended, vue-typescript or vue-all.
story.eslint.nextDesc: For Next.js projects: next-recommended or next-all.
story.eslint.combinedDesc: Combine basic presets to build your own. Note: prettier must be the last one.
story.tools.title: Stylelint & Prettier
story.tools.stylelintLessDesc: Use this one when your project is written in Less.
story.tools.stylelintScssDesc: Use this one when your project is written in SCSS.
story.tools.prettierDesc: Shared Prettier configuration with import sorting and JSDoc plugins.
story.husky.title: Husky & Lint-staged
story.husky.description: Set up git hooks and lint-staged so every commit is linted and formatted automatically.
story.release.title: Changelog & Release
story.release.description: Automate conventional-changelog generation and version release with commit-and-tag-version.
story.release.changelogDesc: Run conventional-changelog with the angular preset.
story.release.releaseDesc: Automated version bump, tagging and CHANGELOG generation, like npm version.
story.meta.eslintPresets: ESLint preset examples: recommended, react, vue, next.js and combined presets.
story.meta.huskySetup: Husky git hooks and lint-staged setup with a terminal demo.
story.meta.changelogRelease: conventional-changelog and commit-and-tag-version scripts for automated releases.
